canonical_term: Lincoln Institute - Measures of Vertical Inequality in Assessments
summary: Research source evaluating conventional vertical inequity measures such as PRD and regression-based measures, including cautions about bias and alternative measures.
plain_language: This source warns that measuring regressivity is technically tricky; some methods can imply regressivity even when it is not present.
